verdict.rationale: Mapping touch and stylus input from a tablet or phone to host pointer events is a fair question for a remote-desktop product like TeamViewer, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers it. The only mobile-related items are a Mobile SDK add-on and mobile device management, which are different features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a power user, touch and stylus input on a tablet or phone maps to pointer events on the host
